# https://github.com/yanzhong07/BCEL/tree/master/BCEL/R

plan(sequential, split=TRUE)

# Helper Functions

```{r}
metrics <- c("vi", "nmi", "split.join", "rand", "adjusted.rand")

evaluate_checker <- function(checker, fitted_mat, row_groups, col_groups) {
  to_return = list()
  
  for (metric in metrics) {
    to_return[[paste(metric, "row", sep = "_")]] <-
      igraph::compare(row_groups,
                      checker$row_partition, method = metric)
    
    to_return[[paste(metric, "col", sep = "_")]] <-
      igraph::compare(col_groups,
                      checker$col_partition, method = metric)
  }
  
  if(is.null(fitted_mat)) {
    to_return$true_err <- NA
  } else {
    to_return$true_err <- mean((checker$centers - fitted_mat)^2)
  }
  to_return
}
```

# Data

```{r}

all_checkers <- list()

noise_levels <- c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2)
extra_dims <- c(0, 100, 250, 500, 1000)

i <- 1
for(noise_level in noise_levels) {
  for (extra_dim in extra_dims) {
    all_checkers[[i]] <- gen_checkerboard(
      200,
      200,
      6,
      6,
      noise = noise_level,
      p_extra = extra_dim,
      prob_empty = 0.25
    )
    all_checkers[[i]]$noise_level = noise_level
    all_checkers[[i]]$extra_dim = extra_dim
    
    i <- i + 1
  }
}

```

# BiCobra

```{r}

all_palm_results = list()
for(checker in 1:1) {
  print(checker)
  all_palm_results[[checker]] <-
    cv.BCBC(
      all_checkers[[checker]]$X,
      lambdas = 2 ^ seq(-6,-4, 1),
      gammas = 2 ^ seq(0, 6, 1),
      progress = TRUE,
      scale_gamma = TRUE,
      recalculate_weights = TRUE
    )
}

```


# Cobra

```{r}

all_cobra_results = list()
for(checker in length(all_checkers)) {
  wts <- fast_gkn_weights(
    t(all_checkers[[checker]]$X),
    k_row = 2,
    k_col = 2,
    phi = 0.5,
    approx = 0
  )
  
  all_cobra_results[[i]] <-
    cobra_validate(
      t(X),
      wts$E_row,
      wts$E_col,
      wts$w_row,
      wts$w_col,
      gamma = 2 ^ seq(3, 16, 0.25),
      max_iter = 500
    )
}

```

# SparseBC

```{r}

run_sparsebc <- function(X, gammas) {
  kr <-
    sparseBC.choosekr(
      X,
      k = 1:10,
      r = 1:10,
      lambda = 0,
      percent = 0.125,
      TRUE
    )

  lambda <- sparseBC.BIC(X,
                         kr$estimated_kr[1, 1],
                         kr$estimated_kr[1, 2],
                         gammas)
  
  sparsebc_fit <- sparseBC(X,
                           kr$estimated_kr[1, 1],
                           kr$estimated_kr[1, 2],
                           lambda$lambda)
  sparsebc_fit
}

all_sparsebc_results = list()
for(checker in 1:length(all_checkers)) {
  all_sparsebc_results[[checker]] <-
    run_sparsebc(all_checkers[[checker]]$X, gammas = gammas=2^seq(-2, 10, 1))
}

```

# BCCC

```{r}

all_bccc_results = list()

all_deltas <- 2^seq(-2, 10, 0.5)
all_alphas <- 2^seq(-2, 2, 0.5)

for(checker in 1:length(all_checkers)) {
  for(delta in all_deltas) {
    for(alpha in all_alphas) {
        temp_result <- biclust(all_checkers[[checker]]$X,
            method = BCCC(),
            alpha = alpha,
            delta = delta,
            number = 36)
    }
  }
}

```
